title: CircleCI MCP Server
summary: Read CircleCI build failures, test results and pipeline status from your agent, then get help fixing the config or the failing job.
description: The CircleCI MCP server lets an agent pull the failure logs of a build, see which tests failed and check the latest pipeline on a branch, so you can say "why is main red" without opening the web app. It can also validate a config file and find flaky tests.

It runs through npx with a personal API token. Some tools do more than read: rerun_workflow and run_pipeline start work on your account. CircleCI marks this package deprecated in favor of its hosted server, so look at the source page for the current recommendation.
useWhen: Find out why the latest pipeline on a branch failed
Read the logs of a failing job and propose a fix
List the flaky tests across recent runs
Validate a config.yml before you push it

mcp.name: circleci
access: Reads pipelines, job logs, test results and artifacts for projects your token can see
Can rerun workflows and trigger pipelines when you ask it to

example.prompt: The build on branch fix/cart-total is red. Get the failure logs and tell me what broke.
example.result: The test job failed in cart.spec.ts: "expected 1999, received 2000". The rounding change in totals.ts rounds before adding tax. Suggested fix: round once after the sum.

faq.question: Does it work with self-hosted CircleCI?
faq.answer: Yes. Set the optional CIRCLECI_BASE_URL variable to your server address.

faq.question: Can it trigger builds?
faq.answer: Yes, through run_pipeline and rerun_workflow. Tell the agent to ask first if you want a check before it starts anything.

access: Reads CircleCI project data with your token
May start pipelines or reruns on request
